name: status-action-cell
title: Status action cell
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A status pill and up to three row actions. Further actions, and every action at 390px, sit in a menu. The accessible name is the status plus the action labels.

meta.descriptionEs: Una pastilla de estado y hasta tres acciones en la fila. El resto, y todas cuando el contenedor mide 390 px, entran en un menú. El nombre accesible junta el estado y las acciones.

examples.title: Celda de estado y acciones
examples.description: Estado, acciones, pendiente y error. es-MX y EN.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, diez acciones, 390 px, RTL y texto largo.

meta.usage: <StatusActionCell label="Paused" tone="warning" actions={[{ id: "resume", label: "Resume", onClick: resume }]} />

api.name: label
api.description: Visible status text. It starts the accessible name.

api.name: tone / status
api.description: neutral, accent, warning, critical, info, or positive. Passed through to status-pill.

api.name: actions
api.description: id, label, onClick, variant, disabled, and pending. At most three stay inline.

api.name: collapse
api.description: True forces the menu. Omit it to collapse at 390px on the viewport or the nearest container.

api.name: density / appearance / maxVisible
api.type: regular | compact / soft | outline | text / number
api.description: Tighter controls, the pill appearance, and how many actions stay inline.

api.name: menuLabel / moreLabel / error
api.description: Visible menu names and an inline alert when an action fails.

docs: Clean-room reading of a status-and-actions cell. Shadcn Studio Pro was not purchased, fetched, or ported. No source, sample rows, icons, or assets were copied. The accessible name is the status label plus the action labels (proposed hub rule RUI-CELL-ACTION-001). Status color comes from status-pill and is never the only signal. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, dropdown-menu, or status-pill. The item ships no theme. Reduced motion adds no animation of its own.
